purpose: geometry/crop review around one pocket; not ball detection or detector accuracy

warp.implementation: VisionAnalyzer.Warp source corners to [W,0], [W,2W], [0,2W], [0,0], then cv2.warpPerspective to W x 2W
warp.displayRotation: 90 degrees counter-clockwise back to landscape for the contact sheet

positiveFrame.referenceSemantics: approximate user-reviewed black-ball interior point; not a ball centre
positiveFrame.doesNotQuantifyBallClipping: The reference is an interior point, not a centre. No black-ball boundary/body fraction is computed.

controlCaveat.note: The empty-mouth frame is from a separate earlier, dimmer capture timeline. It is a spatial visual control only, not a matched-light or same-session comparison.

limitations: The black-ball reference is an approximate interior pixel and is explicitly not a centre label.
No ball body/area clipping fraction can be computed without an independently reviewed centre and boundary.
The calibration quadrilateral is the saved playable-table crop; the overlay shows its relation to the pocket, not a verified physical ball contour.
The control uses a separate, dimmer capture timeline despite identical saved calibration corners.
This is a geometry visualization, not evidence of detection accuracy or proof that warp causes the miss.
